jei.dragom_golems.template.title: Large Golem Blank
jei.dragom_golems.template.desc: Cut it in a stonecutter into any one of the five dragon golem parts (one recipe each for wings / head / body / tail / limbs, each costing one blank).
jei.dragom_golems.template.source: Craft it with one diamond above one iron block (price is temporary).
jei.dragom_golems.part.title: Dragon Golem Part
jei.dragom_golems.part.howto: On an anvil, put the part on the left and the material on the right. One stack must hold at least %s of that material.
jei.dragom_golems.part.formula: Part stats = material stats x this part's weight (Modular Golems also multiplies by the golem type's magnifiers; the dragon type defines none, so it defaults to 1).
jei.dragom_golems.part.limit: Only copper / gold / iron / netherite / sculk have dragon textures drawn for them (sculk takes echo shards). Other golem materials can still be cast in and their stats still apply - the dragon just falls back to the plain grey texture.
jei.dragom_golems.part.weight.head: Weights: attack 1.0
jei.dragom_golems.holder.title: Dragon Golem
jei.dragom_golems.holder.desc: Assemble the five parts in the golem assembly table: W / HBT / L (W wings, H head, B body, T tail, L limbs).
jei.dragom_golems.holder.slot: Equipment screen is dog-typed: two slots, helmet and chestplate.
jei.dragom_golems.holder.hover: Gunship: hovers 10+ blocks above the ground in combat and around 3 blocks while idling, both scaling with body size (x sqrt(size)). Retrieve it with a golem retrieval wand.
